consequence.statement: Write dedupe cache is deprecated and will be removed in Loki 4.0; environments using legacy index types must migrate to TSDB before upgrading to Loki 4.0.

assertion.statement: Write dedupe cache is deprecated in Loki 3.0.0 because it is not required by newer single store indexes (TSDB and boltdb-shipper); users with legacy index types must migrate to TSDB to use Loki 4.0.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: evidence does not specify exact configuration key or path for write dedupe cache; applicability: evidence does not specify which index types or configurations trigger the deprecation; applicability depends on whether environment uses legacy index types, which requires runtime visibility
